desc:
SkateBlox - Join the community discord for updates and ideas, its down in social links !

Real skateboarding on Roblox. Flick-it style controls on the sticks, so every flip, grind and manual is yours to land.

Play together on PC, Xbox and PlayStation. Controller recommended.
 
7 spots to skate: Skate School, University, Downtown, Industrial, Danny Way's mega ramp, the Sanitarium and the Art Gallery.

Build your skater: hundreds of tops, hoodies, jeans, shoes, caps and scarves from the community packs, plus your own board.

Ride, grind, bail. Full ragdoll bails, manuals, reverts, grabs, and lines as long as you can hold them.

Join the Discord for updates, clips and bug reports!
